title: Now panel shows the board name
description:
The Now toolbar needs a left-aligned board title to the left of the Status filter so operators can tell which project they are looking at.

`.kanbus.yml` gains an optional `name` field for the human-readable board title. When `name` is unset or blank, Now uses the repository directory name, then `project_key`.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  nameYaml[".kanbus.yml name"] --> resolve["resolve_board_name"]
  folder["repository folder"] --> resolve
  key["project_key"] --> resolve
  resolve --> header["Now toolbar title"]
```

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Implemented the Now panel board title.

`.kanbus.yml` now accepts optional `name`. When it is unset or blank, the console uses the repository directory name, then `project_key`.

The Now toolbar shows that title left-aligned immediately left of Status. Verified live on Chattic.us at http://127.0.0.1:4248/ (title "Chattic.us" next to Status: In Progress).
